description_en: Supports structured recognition and output of key fields including invoice code, invoice number, invoice date, invoice amount, VAT tax amount, certificate number, purchaser name, and purchaser ID number/code
description_zh: 支持包括发票代码、开票号码、开票日期、发票金额、增值税税额、合格证号、购买方名称、购买方身份证号/代码等关键字段结构化识别输出
kebab_example: aliyun ocr-api recognize-car-invoice --url https://img.alicdn.com/tfs/TB1hC7bXCzqK1RjSZPcXXbTepXa-832-616.jpg --biz-body '图片二进制文件' --region cn-hangzhou
name: RecognizeCarInvoice

parameters.help_en:
Either this field or the body field must be specified. You cannot specify both or leave both empty.
The URL of the image (up to 2048 bytes, base64 not supported)
parameters.help_zh:
本字段和body字段二选一，不可同时透传或同时为空。
图片链接（长度不超2048字节，不支持base64）
parameters.name: url

parameters.help_en:
Either this field or the URL field must be specified. You cannot specify both or leave both empty.
The image binary file, up to 10 MB.
When using HTTP, place the image binary file in the HTTP body for upload.
When using the SDK, place the image in the SDK body
parameters.help_zh:
本字段和URL字段二选一，不可同时透传或同时为空。
图片二进制文件，最大10MB。
使用HTTP方式调用，把图片二进制文件放到HTTP body中上传即可。
使用SDK的方式调用，把图片放到SDK的body中即可
parameters.name: body
